subject: Returns all NAs when adding covariate to mask in multisession SECR

messages.author: 1661308b34ed6271
messages.subject: Returns all NAs when adding covariate to mask in multisession SECR
parts:
Hi all,

I am working with snow leopard camera trapping data. I have detection data from multiple sites (hence, multiple sessions). For modelling variation in density with covariates, I tried to create masks and overlay elevation covariate from raster data using addcovariate function. This does not return an error but elevation values all become NAs. I tried looking this up, and used SpatialGridDataframe. I also tried using one mask from a list of masks. Could someone check what's happening? Thanks in advance!

Here is the code I used
msSL<-read.capthist('captH_SL.txt','trapH_SL.txt', detector = "multi", skip=1)
hp1<-raster("covariate_layers/hp/hp_ele_test1.tif")
hp2<-raster("covariate_layers/hp/hp_ele_test2.tif")
hp<-merge(hp1,hp2)
hp<-as(hp, 'SpatialGridDataFrame')
mask.pin<-make.mask(traps(msSL[[1]]), buffer=28000,type ="trapbuffer")
ovtrap<-addCovariates(mask.pin, hp)
covariates(ovtrap) #this results in NAs

Many thanks,
Manvi

messages.author: 118cea91a1619106
messages.subject: Re: Returns all NAs when adding covariate to mask in multisession SECR
parts:
Hi Manvi
Using a SpatialGridDataFrame as a spatial data source is not tested, as stated in the documentation, but it should work in principle. Have you checked the inputs by plotting mask.pin over the top of hp? If so then please send these objects offline and I'll see where it goes wrong. (Maybe there is a better name than OVtrap!)
Murray
